https://legado.vossc.com

🔥注：阅读请使用最新测试版

💯[打赏VIP无请求限制,专属书源]
2.自定义源站示例：番茄小说,七猫  多个源站用英文,号分隔
源站名参考 登录URL //书源配置列表 v参数
3.源站带有❇️图标表示只能指定或@搜索

4.搜索模式：
书名@来源 多个来源用英文,号分隔
示例： 
系统@番茄小说，多个源站使用英文,号分隔
书名@类型 返回对应类型所有源站数据，可直接使用@方式搜索或者点击登陆切换模式
示例： 
系统@小说  听书  漫画  短剧等
默认书名排序
指定作者优先：
作者名@作者   作者名@作者,源站

<js>
let config = getConfig.call(this);
if (!config.host || !config.gender) {
    config = { gender: "boy", host: getServerHost(), tag: "多元" };
    setConfigs.call(this, config);
    java.toast("配置初始化完成");
}
if (!config.tag) config.tag = "多元";
let obj = (title, url, type) => ({
  title: title,
  url: url,
  style: { layout_flexGrow: 1, layout_flexBasisPercent: type }
});
let sort = [];
let controls = [];
let allSourceOptions = [{label:'☁️聚合搜索', value:''}];
let sourceNameToType = {};
let sourceTypeToNames = {};
try {
    let apiResponse = JSON.parse(java.ajax(getServerHost() + "/api/get_config"));
    if (apiResponse && Array.isArray(apiResponse)) {
        apiResponse.forEach(item => {
            if (item.name && item.key) {
                allSourceOptions.push({
                    label: item.name,
                    value: item.name
                });
                if (item.type) {
                    sourceNameToType[item.name] = item.type;
                    if (!sourceTypeToNames[item.type]) {
                        sourceTypeToNames[item.type] = [];
                    }
                    sourceTypeToNames[item.type].push(item.name);
                }
            }
        });
    }
} catch(e) {
    java.toast("获取源站列表失败，请尝试切换服务器后刷新");
}
let modeOptions = ["📖小说", "🎧听书", "🌈漫画", "▶️视频"];
let modeDisplayToName = {'📖小说':'小说','🎧听书':'听书','🌈漫画':'漫画','▶️视频':'视频'};
let modeNameToDisplay = {'小说':'📖小说','听书':'🎧听书','漫画':'🌈漫画','视频':'▶️视频'};
let modeTypeMap = {'小说':'novel','听书':'audio','漫画':'comic','视频':'video'};
let defaultMode = "📖小说";
let currentModeName = "";
if (config.source) {
    if (modeNameToDisplay[config.source]) {
        defaultMode = modeNameToDisplay[config.source];
        currentModeName = config.source;
    } else if (sourceNameToType[config.source]) {
        let type = sourceNameToType[config.source];
        let typeToMode = {'novel':'📖小说','audio':'🎧听书','comic':'🌈漫画','video':'▶️视频'};
        defaultMode = typeToMode[type] || "📖小说";
        currentModeName = modeDisplayToName[defaultMode] || "小说";
    }
} else {
    currentModeName = "小说";
}
function getSourceOptionsByMode(modeName) {
    let type = modeTypeMap[modeName] || 'novel';
    let options = [{label:'☁️聚合搜索', value:''}];
    if (sourceTypeToNames[type]) {
        sourceTypeToNames[type].forEach(name => {
            options.push({label: name, value: name});
        });
    }
    return options;
}
let currentSourceOptions = getSourceOptionsByMode(currentModeName);
let sourceLabels = currentSourceOptions.map(item => item.label);
let currentSource = config.source || '';
let defaultSourceLabel = '☁️聚合搜索';
let modeNames = ['小说','听书','漫画','视频'];
if (!modeNames.includes(currentSource)) {
    for (let i = 0; i < currentSourceOptions.length; i++) {
        if (currentSourceOptions[i].value == currentSource) {
            defaultSourceLabel = currentSourceOptions[i].label;
            break;
        }
    }
}
let mapObj = {};
currentSourceOptions.forEach(item => { mapObj[item.label] = item.value; });
let mapStr = JSON.stringify(mapObj).replace(/\\/g,'\\\\').replace(/"/g,'\\"');
controls.push({
    title: "☃关键词💭：书名/作者",
    type: "text",
    style: { layout_flexGrow: 1, layout_flexBasisPercent: 0.6 }
});
controls.push({
    title: "🔍搜索",
    type: "button",
    action: "java.searchBook(infoMap['☃关键词💭：书名/作者'] || '', source.bookSourceName + '::' + source.getKey())",
    style: { layout_flexGrow: 1, layout_flexBasisPercent: -1, layout_alignSelf: "baseline" }
});
controls.push({
    title: "🔄刷新",
    type: "button",
    action: "java.refreshExplore()",
    style: { layout_flexGrow: 1, layout_flexBasisPercent: 0.4, layout_alignSelf: "baseline" }
});
controls.push({
    title: "⚙登录",
    type: "button",
    action: "java.open('login','http',null)",
    style: { layout_flexGrow: 1, layout_flexBasisPercent: 0.4, layout_alignSelf: "baseline" }
});
controls.push({
    title: "性别",
    type: "select",
    chars: ["♂️男频", "♀️女频"],
    default: config.gender == "boy" ? "♂️男频" : "♀️女频",
    action: "(function(){ var raw=infoMap['性别']||''; var v=(raw.indexOf('男')>=0)?'boy':'girl'; setConfigs.call(this,{gender:v}); java.refreshExplore(); })()",
    style: { layout_flexGrow: 1, layout_flexBasisPercent: 0.4 }
});
let modeMapStr = JSON.stringify(modeDisplayToName).replace(/\\/g,'\\\\').replace(/"/g,'\\"');
controls.push({
    title: "模式",
    type: "select",
    chars: modeOptions,
    default: defaultMode,
    action: "(function(){ var raw=infoMap['模式']||''; var modeMap=JSON.parse('" + modeMapStr + "'); var modeName=modeMap[raw]||'小说'; setConfigs.call(this,{source:modeName}); java.refreshExplore(); })()",
    style: { layout_flexGrow: 1, layout_flexBasisPercent: 0.4 }
});
let currentStyle = config.imgstyle || "TEXT";
let currentSizeLabel = currentStyle == "TEXT" ? "🔵大号" : "🟢小号";
controls.push({
    title: "段评图标",
    type: "select",
    chars: ["🟢小号", "🔵大号"],
    default: currentSizeLabel,
    action: "(function(){ var raw=infoMap['段评图标']||''; var v='TEXT'; if(raw.indexOf('小号')>=0){ v='text'; } else if(raw.indexOf('大号')>=0){ v='TEXT'; } setConfigs.call(this,{imgstyle:v}); var msg = v=='TEXT'?'大号':'小号'; java.toast('\\n🥽段评气泡-'+msg+'样式'); java.refreshExplore(); })()",
    style: { layout_flexGrow: 1, layout_flexBasisPercent: 0.4 }
});
let sourceOptionsStr = JSON.stringify(currentSourceOptions).replace(/\\/g,'\\\\').replace(/"/g,'\\"');
controls.push({
    title: "源站",
    type: "select",
    chars: sourceLabels,
    default: defaultSourceLabel,
    action: "(function(){ var raw=infoMap['源站']||''; var options=JSON.parse('" + sourceOptionsStr + "'); var map={}; options.forEach(function(item){ map[item.label]=item.value; }); setConfigs.call(this,{source:map[raw]||''}); java.refreshExplore(); })()",
    style: { layout_flexGrow: 1, layout_flexBasisPercent: 0.4 }
});
if (String(config.source || '').indexOf("晋江") >= 0) {
    let tagMap = {"🏷 言情":"言情","🏷 纯爱":"纯爱","🏷 百合":"百合","🏷 无Cp":"无Cp","🏷 多元":"多元"};
    let tagMapStr = JSON.stringify(tagMap).replace(/\\/g,'\\\\').replace(/"/g,'\\"');
    controls.push({
        title: "标签频道",
        type: "select",
        chars: ["🏷 言情", "🏷 纯爱", "🏷 百合", "🏷 无Cp", "🏷 多元"],
        default: "🏷 " + (config.tag || "多元"),
        action: "(function(){ var raw=infoMap['标签频道']||''; var tagMap=JSON.parse('" + tagMapStr + "'); var tagName=tagMap[raw]||'多元'; setConfigs.call(this,{tag:tagName}); java.refreshExplore(); })()",
        style: { layout_flexGrow: 1, layout_flexBasisPercent: 1 }
    });
}

let currentType = config.gender || "";
let currentSource2 = config.source || "";
let firstSource = String(currentSource2).split(',')[0].trim();

const getGenderDisplayName = (gender) => {
  if (gender == "boy") return "男频";
  if (gender == "girl") return "女频";
  return "";
};
const genderDisplay = getGenderDisplayName(currentType);
const excludedSources = ["小说", "听书", "漫画", "视频", "短剧", "音频", "番茄小说"];
if (firstSource && !excludedSources.includes(firstSource)) {
  try {
    let jjTypeId = config.type_id || '';
    let apiUrl = `${getServerHost()}/type_api?source=${firstSource}`;
    if (currentType) {
      apiUrl += `&gender=${currentType}`;
    }
    if (jjTypeId) {
      apiUrl += `&type=${jjTypeId}`;
    }
    if (config.tag) {
      apiUrl += `&tag=${encodeURIComponent(config.tag)}`;
    }
    let response = JSON.parse(java.ajax(apiUrl));
    if (response.data.found) {
      response.data.found.forEach(item => {
        let finalUrl = "";
        if (item.url) {
          if (item.url.includes('jj_signin') || item.url.includes('jjbookshelf')) {
            finalUrl = item.url;
          } else {
            finalUrl = `${getServerHost()}/type_api?source=${firstSource}&page={{page}}&url=${item.url}`;
            if (currentType) {
              finalUrl += `&gender=${currentType}`;
            }
            if (config.tag) {
              finalUrl += `&tag=${encodeURIComponent(config.tag)}`;
            }
          }
        }
        sort.push({
          title: item.title,
          url: finalUrl,
          style: item.style || { layout_flexGrow: 1, layout_flexBasisPercent: 0.29 }
        });
      });
    } else {
      sort.push({
        title: `【${firstSource}】${genderDisplay ? `【${genderDisplay}】` : ''}暂无数据`,
        url: "",
        style: { layout_flexGrow: 1, layout_flexBasisPercent: 1 }
      });
    }
  } catch(e) {
    sort.push({
      title: `【${firstSource}】${genderDisplay ? `【${genderDisplay}】` : ''}暂无数据`,
      url: "",
      style: { layout_flexGrow: 1, layout_flexBasisPercent: 1 }
    });
  }
  sort = controls.concat(sort);
  JSON.stringify(sort);
} else {
  let recommendUrl = getServerHost() + "/read_recommend?session=" + getSessionId();
  sort.push({

    url: recommendUrl,

  sort.push({

    style: { layout_flexGrow: 1, layout_flexBasisPercent: 0.29 }
  });
  sort.push({
    title: '出版榜单',

    style: { layout_flexGrow: 1, layout_flexBasisPercent: 0.29 }
  });
  sort.push({
    title: '爆更榜单',
    url: 'https://api-lf.fanqiesdk.com/api/novel/channel/homepage/rank/rank_list/v2/?aid=13&limit=50&offset={{(page-1)*100}}&side_type=15&type=1',
    style: { layout_flexGrow: 1, layout_flexBasisPercent: 0.29 }
  });
  sort.push({
    title: '黑马榜单',
    url: 'https://api-lf.fanqiesdk.com/api/novel/channel/homepage/rank/rank_list/v2/?aid=13&limit=50&offset={{(page-1)*100}}&side_type=13&type=1',
    style: { layout_flexGrow: 1, layout_flexBasisPercent: 0.29 }
  });
  sort.push({

    url: 'https://api-lf.fanqiesdk.com/api/novel/channel/homepage/rank/rank_list/v2/?aid=13&limit=50&offset={{(page-1)*100}}&side_type=12&type=1',
    style: { layout_flexGrow: 1, layout_flexBasisPercent: 0.29 }
  });
  let showCategories = currentType == "girl" ? [0] : [1];
  showCategories.forEach(genderCode => {
    let isMale = genderCode == 1;
    let genderLabel = isMale ? "男频" : "女频";
    let categories = isMale ? [
      {id: 1141, name: "西方奇幻"},

          layout_flexGrow: 1,
          layout_flexBasisPercent: 0.29

  let hasValidSession = false;

      username = uinfo.data.name;
      hasValidSession = true;
    }
  } catch (e) {
  }
  if (!hasValidSession) {
    java.toast("番茄登录已过期，请重新登录");
  }
  let gro = [];
  let pushGro = (title, url, type) => gro.push(obj(title, url, type));
  let sArr = [];
  if (hasValidSession) {
    try {
      let book_shelf_info = JSON.parse(java.ajax(getServerHost() + "/book_shelf?session=" + getSessionId()));
      if (book_shelf_info.code == 0) {
        let groups_bookids = { "未分组": [] };
        book_shelf_info.data.book_shelf_info.forEach(i => {
          if (!groups_bookids[i.group_name ? i.group_name : "未分组"]) 
            groups_bookids[i.group_name] = [];
          groups_bookids[i.group_name ? i.group_name : "未分组"].push(i.book_id);
        });
        Object.keys(groups_bookids).forEach(k => {
          pushGro(k, "https://fanqienovel.com/fqbookshelf/groupName/" + k, 0.4);
        });
        if (Object.keys(groups_bookids).length % 2 != 0) pushGro("占位", "", 0.4);
        sArr.push(obj(username + '的个人中心', '', 1));
        sArr.push(obj("我的书架", "https://fanqienovel.com/fqbookshelf", 1));
        sArr = sArr.concat(gro);
        sArr.push(obj("阅读历史", getServerHost() + "/read_history?session=" + getSessionId() + "&page={{page}}", 1));
      } else {
        java.toast("获取书架信息失败，登录可能已过期");
      }
    } catch (e) {
      java.toast("番茄登录过期，已隐藏个人中心");
    }
  } else {
    java.toast("您还未登录番茄账号，无法同步数据");
  }
  sort = sArr.concat(sort);
  sort = controls.concat(sort);
  JSON.stringify(sort);
}

    let res = JSON.parse(java.hexDecodeToString(result));
    
    if (res.source == "番茄小说" && (getConfig.call(this).fqdown == "on")) {
        book.type = 128;
        java.toast('\n正在准备TXT，请等待后端缓存完毕后点击阅读导入…');

    let request = getServerHost() + `/details,${JSON.stringify({
        method: "POST",
        body: res
    })}`;
    
    result = java.ajax(request);
    let response = JSON.parse(result);
    if (response.data.tab == "download") {
       book.type = 128;
    }
}

result;

<js>
function getBookIdFull(url) {
    const {java} = this;
    let $ = JSON.parse(url).data;
    let arr = [];
    if ($.book_shelf_info && $.book_shelf_info.length > 0) {
        arr = $.book_shelf_info.map(item => item.book_id);
    } else if ($.data_list && $.data_list.length > 0) {
        arr = $.data_list.map(item => item.book_id_str);
    } else {
        java.toast("获取 book_id 失败，你可能需要登录！");
    }
    return arr;
}

let session = getSessionId()

getShelf = () => {
    let book_shelf_info = java.ajax(getServerHost() + "/book_shelf?session=" + session)
    
    bid = getBookIdFull(book_shelf_info)
    
    let id_list = splitArray(bid, 200)
    let urls = []
    id_list.forEach(i => {
        urls.push(getServerHost() +"/detail?book_id=" + i.join(","))
    })
    res = java.ajaxAll(urls)

    let resp = {book_info: []}
    res.forEach(r => {
        resp.book_info = resp.book_info.concat(JSON.parse(r.body()).data)
    })

    return resp
}

function getByGroupName(name) {
    let book_shelf_info = JSON.parse(java.ajax(getServerHost() +"/book_shelf?session=" + session))
    
    let group_bookids = {
        "未分组": []
    }
    book_shelf_info.data.book_shelf_info.forEach(i => {
        if (!group_bookids[i.group_name ? i.group_name : "未分组"]) group_bookids[i.group_name] = []
        group_bookids[i.group_name ? i.group_name : "未分组"].push(i.book_id)
    })
    
    if (!group_bookids[decodeURIComponent(name)]) return {data: []}
    
    let book_ids = splitArray(group_bookids[decodeURIComponent(name)], 200)
    let urls = []

    book_ids.forEach(i => { 	urls.push(getServerHost() +"/detail?book_id=" + i.join(","))
    })
    
    res = java.ajaxAll(urls)

    let resp = {book_info: []}
    res.forEach(r => {
        resp.book_info = resp.book_info.concat(JSON.parse(r.body()).data)
    })

    return resp
}

function getByTabIndex(index) {
    let url = _mlsec.requestHeader(
        "bookmall/tab",
        "version_name=5.8.9.32",
        null,
        "sessionid=" + session
    )
    let all = JSON.parse(java.ajax(url))
    let tab = all.data.tab_item[0].cell_data[index].cell_data
    if (!tab) tab = []
    let bookList = []
    for (let i of tab) {
        bookList = bookList.concat(i.book_data)
    }
    return { book_info: bookList }
}

function getGuessYouLike() {
    let apiUrl = 'https://reading.snssdk.com/reading/bookapi/bookmall/tab/v/?version_name=5.8.9.32&device_id=1024&device_type=114514&iid=2048&aid=1967&channel=0&os_version=0&app_name=novelapp&version_code=58932&device_platform=android'
    let response = java.ajax(apiUrl + ', ' + JSON.stringify({
        headers: {
            'Cookie': "sessionid=" + session
        }
    }))
    let responseData = JSON.parse(response)
    let finalResult = {
        code: 0,
        message: 'SUCCESS',
        data: {
            cell_view: {
                book_data: []
            }
        }
    }
    if (responseData.data && responseData.data.tab_item && responseData.data.tab_item.length > 0 && responseData.data.tab_item[0].cell_data && responseData.data.tab_item[0].cell_data.length > 0 && responseData.data.tab_item[0].cell_data[0].cell_data && responseData.data.tab_item[0].cell_data[0].cell_data.length > 0 && responseData.data.tab_item[0].cell_data[0].cell_data[0].book_data) {
        finalResult.data.cell_view.book_data = responseData.data.tab_item[0].cell_data[0].cell_data[0].book_data
    }
    return finalResult
}

function normalizeResponse(data) {
    if (data.data && data.data.book_list && Array.isArray(data.data.book_list)) {
        return data.data.book_list;
    }
    
    if (data.book_info) return data.book_info;
    if (data.data && data.data.book_info) return data.data.book_info;
    if (data.data && Array.isArray(data.data)) return data.data;
    if (data.list) return data.list;
    if (data.book_list) return data.book_list;
    if (data.data && data.data.publication_list) return data.data.publication_list;
    if (data.result) return data.result;
    if (data.data && data.data.result) return data.data.result;
    if (data.data && data.data.cell_view && data.data.cell_view.book_data) {
        return data.data.cell_view.book_data;
    }
    if (data.data && data.data.records) return data.data.records;
    if (data.data && data.data.list) return data.data.list;
    
    return [];
}

if (baseUrl.includes("jj_signin")) {
    let decodedToken = java.base64Decode(JJtoken());
    let timestamp = Date.now();
    let enbody = timestamp + ':' + decodedToken;
    let encodedEnbody = encode(enbody);
    
    let signUrl = "https://android.jjwxc.net/androidapi/signin,{\"method\":\"POST\",\"body\":\"versionCode=507&sign=" + encodedEnbody + "\"}";
    
    let signinResult = java.ajax(signUrl);
    
    let result = JSON.parse(signinResult);
    let message = result.message || "签到请求完成";
    
    let responseData = {
        "isSuccess": result.code == "200",
        "errorMsg": result.code == "200" ? "success" : "fail",
        "data": [{
            "title": message
        }]
    };
    
    JSON.stringify(responseData);
} else if (baseUrl.includes("jjbookshelf")) {
    let token = JJtoken();
    let config = getConfig.call(this);
    let latestType = config.type_id || '';
    let jjUrl = baseUrl.replace(/type=[^&]*/, 'type=' + latestType);
    if (!/type=/.test(jjUrl)) {
        jjUrl += (jjUrl.includes('?') ? '&' : '?') + 'type=' + latestType;
    }
    jjUrl = jjUrl + token;
    result = JSON.parse(java.ajax(jjUrl));
    JSON.stringify(result);
} else if (baseUrl.includes("type_style")) {
    let sortKey = getSortKey() || '';
    let newUrl = baseUrl + sortKey;
    result = JSON.parse(java.ajax(newUrl));
    
    let normalizedData = normalizeResponse(result);
    JSON.stringify({data: normalizedData});
} else if (baseUrl.endsWith("bookshelf")) {
    result = getShelf("bookshelf/info")
} else if(/read_history/.test(baseUrl)) {
    let pageMatch = baseUrl.match(/page=(\d+)/);
    let page = pageMatch ? pageMatch[1] : '1';
    
    let history_response = java.ajax(getServerHost() + "/read_history?session=" + session + "&page=" + page)
    let history_data = JSON.parse(history_response)
    
    if (history_data.data.data_list) {
        let book_ids = history_data.data.data_list.map(item => item.book_id_str)
        
        let id_list = splitArray(book_ids, 200)
        let urls = []
        id_list.forEach(i => {
          urls.push(getServerHost() +"/detail?book_id=" + i.join(","))
        })
        
        let resp = {book_info: []}
        urls.forEach(url => {
            let detailResponse = java.ajax(url)
            let detailData = JSON.parse(detailResponse)
            if (detailData.data) {
                resp.book_info = resp.book_info.concat(detailData.data)
            }
        })
        
        result = resp
    } else {
        result = {book_info: []}
    }
} else if (baseUrl.includes("style_top")) {
    result = JSON.parse(result);
} else if (baseUrl.includes("/tab/cai")) {
    result = getGuessYouLike();
} else {
    let w = baseUrl.split("/")
    if (baseUrl.includes("groupName")) {
        result = getByGroupName(w[w.length - 1])
    } else if (baseUrl.includes("tab")) {
        result = getByTabIndex(parseInt(w[w.length - 1]))
    } else {
        result = JSON.parse(result)
        if (result.data && result.data.data) {
            result = {book_info: result.data.data}
        }
    }
}

if (!baseUrl.includes("jjbookshelf") && !baseUrl.includes("type_style") && !baseUrl.includes("jj_signin")) {
    let normalizedData = normalizeResponse(result);
    JSON.stringify({data: normalizedData})
}
</js>

let catalog = {source: res.source, url: res.url, name: res.name, bookid: res.bookid || "", tab: res.tab || "novel"};

showTabTips(catalog);

let op = {method: "POST", body: catalog};

let catalogUrl = getServerHost() + `/catalog,${JSON.stringify(op)}`;
let response = java.ajax(catalogUrl);
//java.log(response);

let device = deviceType() ? 'ios' : 'android';

if (device == 'android') {
    var typeMap = {audio:32, comic:64};
    book.type = catalog.tab in typeMap ? typeMap[catalog.tab] : 8;
} else {
    var typeMap = {audio:1, comic:2, video:3};
    book.type = catalog.tab in typeMap ? typeMap[catalog.tab] : 0;
}

JSON.parse(response).data.map((x) => {
    if (x.isVolume == true) {
        x.url = "";
        return x;
    }
    
    x.url = buildChapterUrl(x, catalog);
    return x;
});
